---
title: "Summarize groups"
---

Count the penguins, and find the mean and largest body mass, for each
species, then sort the species by mean mass.
[`penguins`](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets#penguins) has size
measurements for 344 penguins near Palmer Station, Antarctica, from 2007 to
2009 (Gorman et al., 2014).

{{< include pages/_group-and-summarize.md >}}

- `summarize()` after `group_by('species')` returns one row per species.
- `n()` counts every row in the group, including the Adelie and the Gentoo
  penguin with no recorded mass.
- `naRm: true` leaves missing values out of `mean()` and `max()`. Without it,
  the Adelie and Gentoo results are NA, as in R.
- Gentoo penguins are the heaviest, with a mean of about 5,076 g.

Reference: [Single-table functions](../reference/single-table.qmd#summaries) ·
